name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution + sentence-level rewrite suggestions (guidance, never auto-rewrite). Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v6.1.0: report explainer & hardened feedback — new pp_explain.py (pp.py explain) turns any workflow/detect JSON into a plain-language three-part reading (verdict / evidence / action checklist with concrete next commands); error glossary extended to the remaining technical phrases (AST self-verification hits, baseline drift, signature rejection, gate-layer fallback) with next-step lines on pp_verify and the pp.py passthrough; quickstart sub-steps carry 180s timeouts and the gate layers' timeout+retry is now documented as part of the stability contract; architecture deep-dive moved to references/architecture.md; new references/best-practices.md and scenario-annotated samples. No engine scoring changes — published numbers bit-reproducible. 零新增依赖。
